functions.name: ASK
functions.description: Ask Eden a question, optionally about a range of cells. Uses your Eden account's included AI; answers are saved, so recalculating doesn't ask again.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: What to ask, for example "Which product sold most?" or "Translate to French".

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Optional: the cells Eden should look at (at most 5,000 with data; whole columns are fine).
